name: Skullsplitter Tusks
summary: In Booty Bay, Kebok struggles to fill orders for tiger fangs bound for the South Seas. Real fangs cost too much to supply, so he has found another way to meet demand.

sections.title: A Lucrative Substitute
sections.body: Kebok’s trade in tiger fangs for buyers across the South Seas has grown costly and hard to supply through ordinary hunting. So he has found a way to shape horn-like objects into convincing fangs without leaving a sign of the trick. Skullsplitter troll tusks make the closest match. Kebok hires adventurers to take eighteen from the jungle tribe for his next shipment.

faq.q: Why does Kebok need Skullsplitter tusks?
faq.answer: Hunting enough real tigers for South Seas buyers has grown too costly and difficult. Kebok can shape troll tusks into convincing tiger fangs without leaving a trace, keeping his monthly export orders supplied.
Trading partners on islands throughout the South Seas buy the counterfeit fangs.

faq.q: Where does this task fall in Kebok's chain?
faq.answer: This follows Kebok’s earlier request for Bloodscalp Ears.
